paragraphs.text: dsh用来进行数学计算的工具整合包，内含多个数学工具
An aggregate DeepSeek Harness bundle that installs three math plugins at once:

| dsh-math | `math` | mathjs | numeric evaluation, simplification, symbolic differentiation |
| dsh-
wolfram | `wolfram` | Wolfram Mathematica | integrals, equation solving, limits, series, special fun

ctions |
| dsh-diffgeom | `diffgeom` | SymPy.diffgeom | manifold/coordinate/tensor math: exterior de
rivative `d`, wedge `∧`, Lie derivative, covariant derivative, Christoffel/Riemann/Ricci |
Install one bundle and all three tools become available.

- `dsh-math` — none (pure JS).
- `dsh-wolfram` — Wolfram Engine or Mathematica providing `wolframscr

ipt`.
- `dsh-diffgeom` — Python 3 with SymPy: `python -m pip install sympy`.
Missing prerequisites degrade gracefully per tool: `dsh-math` always works, while `dsh-wolfram` / `d
sh-diffgeom` return an `Error:` message if their backend is absent.
